cases.expected: NumericIndicator whose getValue(i) returns 8 for any index i (3 + 5)
cases.description: Add a constant indicator (value 5) to a NumericIndicator wrapping a constant 3. The result should be a new NumericIndicator that yields the sum (8) for all indices.

cases.expected: NumericIndicator whose getValue(i) returns 6 for any index i (3 + 3)
cases.description: Add the NumericIndicator to itself. The sum operation should double the original values, producing 6 for each index.
Passing a null indicator should result in a NullPointerException, as the sum operation cannot be performed with a null operand.

cases.expected: NumericIndicator whose getValue(0) returns 5 (3 + 2) and getValue(1) returns 5 (3 + 2)
cases.description: Add a PreviousValueIndicator that always returns 2 to a NumericIndicator wrapping constant 3. The resulting indicator should correctly sum the two underlying values for each index.

input.value: NumericIndicator wrapping an indicator that throws IndexOutOfBoundsException for index < 0

cases.expected: IndexOutOfBoundsException when getValue is called with a negative index
cases.description: Ensure that exceptions from the 'other' indicator are propagated through the summed NumericIndicator. Calling getValue with a negative index should trigger the same exception.
